div.div:
Key: PII/PHI marks personal or health data; red dashed boxes are trust boundaries.
Gaps (not drawn):
• Only PII is treated as sensitive (Darrel, 2026-10-06; AD-21). Medical facts are not marked, although all of them travel to the model.
• Can a redacted page still carry personal identifiers? The redaction service does not process text inside embedded images (spine open question), and no source states what happens when redaction misses an item.
• How long are original PDFs kept, and who may delete them? No source states retention or deletion.
• What do logs and traces retain? The spine says logs never carry page text, quotes or fact values, but says nothing about the redaction service's JSON entity list, which names what was found.
• Where do the Foundry model deployments process data? Not settled in the spine (open question).
Each element's source is in grey under its name and in its tooltip.
